mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.uid,u.username,c.display_id,c.cid,u.realname,c.pid,c.time,c.status,c.checked,c.submit_id,c.submit_time, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contest_record first_ac WHERE first_ac.pid = c.pid AND first_ac.submit_id < c.submit_id AND ) AS first_blood FROM contest_record c JOIN user_info u ON u.uuid = c.uid WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contest_record earlier WHERE earlier.uid = c.uid AND earlier.pid = c.pid AND earlier.cpid = c.cpid AND earlier.submit_id < c.submit_id AND ) ORDER BY c.checked ASC, c.submit_time ASC, c.submit_id ASC

SELECT cr.id,cr.cid,cr.uid,cr.pid,cr.cpid,cr.display_id,cr.submit_id,u.username,cr.status,cr.submit_time, cr.time,cr.score,cr.use_time,cr.checked,cr.gmt_create,cr.gmt_modified, u.gender,u.realname,u.avatar,u.school,u.nickname FROM contest_record cr JOIN user_info u ON u.uuid = cr.uid WHERE AND cr.score IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contest_record better WHERE better.uid = cr.uid AND better.pid = cr.pid AND better.cpid = cr.cpid AND (better.score > cr.score OR (better.score = cr.score AND better.submit_id < cr.submit_id)) AND )
